whatChangedSinceAFC466: 0003 deliberately does NOT create attendance_sessions (suite 70 pins its absence; the header belongs to the capture slice that owns the Directus collection). counts.session is therefore a bare uuid with a merge contract naming the exact FK the owning slice must add (the 0001->0002 WECA pattern), and the 0003 down script drops only what 0003 created. If the owning slice has landed when suite 71 runs, its tripwire fails loudly rather than forking.
whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: New migration creating service_type_definitions (key unique, ordered-categories jsonb, sex-split/BSC flags, status; eleven seed rows idempotent) and attendance_counts (session bare uuid NOT NULL, 10-value category, other-label CHECK, sex enum default unspecified, count >= 0, unique (session,category,sex), session+category indexes); conditional service_type_def denorm; rerunnable legacy-five-column backfill into sex=unspecified rows (men/women deliberately unmapped); app ceiling SELECT + INSERT/UPDATE, no DELETE, key insertable never updatable; no roles, no triggers, no durations. Down script refuses on any rows, drops denorm column where present, then counts and definitions. Suite 71 proves seed shape, rerun stability, backfill values, constraints, idempotent retry, male+female reconcile, app ceiling, and report-filter partitioning against a self-cleaning fixture sessions table. Shared layer gains AttendanceCount/ServiceTypeDefinition types, zod schemas (count>=0, other-label required, capture batch + report query contracts), collection constants, and matrix cells per expansion section 11.
